productBanner.heading: NMC Verification API
productBanner.tagline: Instantly Verify Medical Professional Registration with NMC in Real Time

inlineImageAndParagraph.text: NMC Verification confirms a medical professional's registration with India's National Medical Commission (NMC), the statutory body regulating medical education and practice. Decentro's API instantly validates doctor credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official registry, returning name, qualification, and status in real time.

items.description: Pass the NMC registration number of the medical professional to be verified to initiate the real-time lookup against the official National Medical Commission registry.
Decentro queries the official NMC database in real time, instantly validating the provided registration number against the most current practitioner records.
Fetch the doctor's full name, qualification, registration date, and current status in a structured response, ensuring comprehensive and verified practitioner data.
